stem.text: Which graph represents a metallic conductor, where the resistance of the conductor is given by the gradient of the graph?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled V and horizontal axis labelled I, origin marked 0, showing a straight line.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled V and horizontal axis labelled I, origin marked 0, showing a curve.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled V, origin marked 0, showing a curve.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis labelled I and horizontal axis labelled V, origin marked 0, showing a straight line.
